'''Adapted Reekers''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Adapted Parasites|Adapted]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawns after a [[Primitive Reeker]] accumulates a killcount of 30 and [[Evolution System|evolves]].
* Spawns in groups of 2 to 3, if [[Ubiquitous Development]] is Level 3 or higher, with a spawnweight of 15.
* Spawns inside the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 10.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Adapted Reekers are Fast moving Melee Combatants with a destructive AoE charge.
* Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage, which inflicts Poison II for 5 seconds.
*If the [[Generations|Generation]] is 4 or higher, Adapted Reekers can perform the following abilities:
**A charge attack. After staying still for some seconds, they'll charge forward. This attack inflicts very high damage per second, ignores immunity frames, and inflicts great knockback and AoE Damage.
*** This is telegraphed by flame particles and a significantly louder and higher pitched growl. They will also stand still before performing this attack.
** Like other Adapted land Parasites, vomit [[Residue]] in a 5x5 area every so often.
* Adapted Reekers can perform small leaps, on land and in liquids.
* Adapted Reekers can sink in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* Adapted Reekers can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 3, with a 40 ticks cooldown and 1 Blocks range.
{{Variants|count=3|Berserker=BerserkerAdaReeker.png|Virulent=VirulentAdaReeker.png|Breacher=BreacherAdaReeker.png}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
* Adapted Reekers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Adapted Reekers' Tendrils, found on their "belly", can reset their [[Adaptation System|adaptation]], while also giving them the [[Bleeding]] and [[Rage]] Effects.

=== ''Post Death'' ===
* On death, Adapted Reekers have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Adapted Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
** If at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension, Adapted Reekers will become [[Primitive Reeker|Primitive Reekers]] upon death instead.
